title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: Aerial view of a coffee agroforestry system in the Colombian Andes. The multiple vertical strata are evident, beginning with the coffee plantation, followed by banana plants (Musa sp.), and the irregular canopy formed by trees from the genera Ficus, Erythrina, Cedrela, Zanthoxylum, among others. This structural complexity of shade in coffee farms enhances the presence of birds from different ecological guilds that inhabit the landscape. The path crossing the plantation facilitates the movement of materials and workers throughout the farm. Full details are available in the article by Botero-Delgadillo et al, https://doi.org/10.1111/1365-2664.70414.
